title: Director's Rule 5-013, Business License Tax Threshold and Standard Deduction
issuer: City of Seattle, Office of City Finance

passages.question: How much standard deduction is left for the Q3 return?
passages.excerpt: Taxpayers filing business license tax returns on a quarterly installment basis shall apply the entire $2 million standard deduction toward taxable amounts commencing with the earliest quarter in the calendar year that the taxpayer has taxable revenue until the $2 million standard deduction amount is reached ... A taxpayer may not carry forward to a subsequent tax year amounts of their $2 million standard deduction that they were unable to apply during the current tax year.
